action_items: (nit) ProductForm DialogContent lacks aria-describedby/DialogDescription — triggers a Radix dev warning. Add a visually-hidden <DialogDescription> for a11y.
(nit) OpenCC s2twp converts tag 'UI批量' → 'UI批次'. If admins want the literal string, document the behavior or echo the normalized tag in the success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _orders_query includes {user_id: q.strip()} in $or even when q is a free-text search (e.g. 'abc'). This is harmless (no match) but slightly wasteful; consider only adding user_id branch when q matches a user_id prefix.

server.py admin_list_orders by_status aggregate recomputes a secondary query stripping 'status' and 'info_submitted' from the match — correct, but when info='rejected' it keeps the info_rejected filter, so the by_status counts are already filtered by info_rejected. Confirm this matches admin UX expectation (tab counts should probably always reflect everything in the current non-status filter, which it does).

server.py admin_bulk_products 'delete' hard-deletes products via delete_many without any cascade check (orders referencing items.product_id can be orphaned). Low priority as /orders snapshots product_name/image at order time, but worth a soft-delete / active=false suggestion for safety.
server.py admin_export_orders .to_list(20000) — if orders collection ever exceeds 20k the export silently truncates. Consider streaming row-by-row or paginated chunks.

server.py _spec_limit: when spec.limit is empty string, falls back to badge inference (good); but if admin sets limit='none' with a badge like 每日一單, orders are unlimited (confirmed working). UI should probably warn admins visually when badge-limit conflicts with explicit limit=none (minor UX).

ProductsAdmin BulkBar: after bulk action the selection state is kept but the server-side list refreshes; if a selected id was deleted, it stays in `sel` state. Clear sel after action to avoid stale selection UI.
